routes.detail: SafeRoute name Exports renders lazy ExportsPage; lazy import at line 300. Source registration verified, mounted runtime not exercised.

purpose: Manage the returned export-job history through download, inspection, loaded-row CSV/JSON export and confirmed bulk deletion, alongside an independently gated catalog-based Helix redaction advisor.
primaryGoal: Find a relevant past job, download a ready artifact, or safely remove selected jobs without losing failed selections or misrepresenting loaded-list coverage.

dataSources.name: Export job snapshot
dataSources.contract: exportKeys.jobs = ['export-jobs']; request forwards AbortSignal; safeArray selection; default active queued/processing polling every 5000 ms; no page vehicle/date bounds or server pagination arguments.
dataSources.payload: ExportJobSummary snake_case fields id, type, format, status, created_at, optional vehicle_id/file_name/file_size/record_count/error_message/duration_ms/completed_at. Page displays six columns; no measurement/unit conversion beyond bytes display.
dataSources.evidenceLimit: Router registration only. Handler authorization, list limits/order, worker completion, artifact contents and current responses were not exercised.

dataSources.name: Destructive bulk delete
dataSources.contract: JSON body {ids: string[], op: 'delete'}; ExportBulkResult {deleted, failed: [{id,reason}]}; success invalidates and broadcasts jobs/all caches, then success toast; rejection shows error toast.
dataSources.evidenceLimit: No mutation performed. Partial success response possibilities are evidenced by the interface, not a demonstrated backend response.

dataSources.name: Ready artifact download
dataSources.contract: Native download link only for ready jobs. Absolute /api/v1 URL is direct navigation, not a double-prefixed request() call.
dataSources.evidenceLimit: No download/navigation performed; external-server/native base-URL equivalence and auth response not verified.

dataSources.name: Loaded-list statistics
dataSources.contract: Derived solely from loaded jobs; counts every truthy job, counts known statuses, sums only positive finite file_size bytes. Queued + processing is inProgress. Unknown statuses remain in total and bytes, but not known-status bars. Summary is unaffected by table search, value filters, pagination and selection.
dataSources.evidenceLimit: No all-time/fleet/date-bounded guarantee. Unknown source is not a zero; hasData false passes null raw metrics. A known zero byte footprint is intentionally displayed as an em dash.

dataSources.name: Opt-in redaction narration
dataSources.registration: internal\api\router.go:2846-2851,5100 wires PiiRedactionSharedExports handler; exact downstream route registration not inspected
dataSources.contract: Explicit selection of drives/charging/trips/analytics/backup/account; request body {export_type}; withAiFeature('pii-redaction-shared-exports') visibility gate; AIFeatureCard inputSlot, canStart, stream. Narrates static catalog privacy guidance rather than reading export rows or submitting an export.
dataSources.evidenceLimit: Frontend URL and router handler wiring inspected. Exact AI route registration, feature gate implementation, provider/tool behavior and SSE runtime unverified. Comments referencing historical tests are not current proof.

dataSources.name: Table-scoped local CSV/JSON
dataSources.contract: Selected scope uses selected loaded rows; other scope uses filteredData because page supplies no exportAll. Serializes visible columns, CSV favors rendered text, JSON prefers compatible raw fields. Default filename is tableId-derived. Scope description explicitly states matching loaded rows or selected loaded rows.
dataSources.evidenceLimit: Do not call this server full-result export or equate table CSV/JSON with the downloadable job artifact. No file generated.

components.name: PageLayout / LayoutCard
components.contract: PageLayout aliases PageContainer props, passes query/title/subtitle/secondaryActions and full-width min-w-0 container. LayoutCard keeps semantic generated heading association, shared Card surface and footer/actions capabilities.

components.name: ExportKpiBand -> OperationalBrief
components.contract: Five source-backed count/bytes metrics; compact/loading; localized source status tone/label; scope, last-success freshness, provenance, narrative limitations and specialist formatBytes formatter. Existing shared stats pipeline, not a replacement KPI grid. OperationalBrief internals not inspected.

components.name: DataTable, Button, Badge, Text, ConfirmDialog
components.contract: Stable tableId exports:jobs, six columns, value filters, sortable data columns, controlled multiselection, row labels, default page size 25/options 25,50,100, sticky header/maxHeight 640, column visibility/layout/width persistence and default local search/density/CSV/JSON. Shared confirmation owns overlay; focus internals not inspected.

components.name: ExportStatusBreakdown -> MetricBar
components.contract: Known nonzero statuses in stable order, count/loaded-total percentage and known storage bytes; independent skeleton/error/unresolved/empty branches. MetricBar already supports size slim/default and fill solid/gradient, named progressbar and reduced-motion hook.

components.name: Data trust and recovery
components.contract: fatalError rather than raw query error; retained rows with source notice; initial skeleton, QueryError retry, paused/unresolved status text, genuine empty state. No invented offline measurements.

components.name: AIPiiRedactionSharedExports -> AIFeatureCard
components.contract: Type Select input, contextual suggestion action, disabled until input/while streaming, aria-busy and Ask Helix contextual accessible name, independent output stream. Preserve consent/gating, catalog-only explanation and baseline jobs view.

components.name: FadeIn / formatting / localization / Icons
components.owner: Existing category barrels and formatting hooks
components.contract: Existing React/i18n hooks, page title, byte/date formatting and decorated-icon aria-hidden. Caller uses shared motion wrappers; actual reduced-motion behavior unverified.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Table and status panel repeat loading/error/unresolved/empty branching, but share one source and existing feedback primitives; this is legitimate panel-specific presentation, not evidence requiring another state engine.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Retain both independently visible panels; consider existing SourceContent only after equivalent retained and unresolved contracts are verified.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Summary and status panel both show known byte totals; distinct summary and distribution contexts make this purposeful duplication.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Keep both explanations and formatting semantics; do not remove a metric merely to reduce repetition.

responsive.strategy: One-column detail grid below xl; at xl jobs span 2/3, breakdown 1/3. PageLayout has min-w-0/full-width container. Download link has min-h-11.

issues.detail: Mobile allowlist retains only type/status/actions; format, file size and created date receive hidden md:table-cell from DataTable. No mobilePresentation or expanded-detail renderer is passed, so no inspected page path restores these hidden details at narrow widths.
issues.fix: Use the existing opt-in MobileDataTablePresentation with complete job details, selection and download, or a non-lossy existing table strategy. Preserve identical loaded-row search/filter/sort/pagination/export pipeline and persisted columns.

visualIssues.detail: Processing uses fluorescent #00f0ff; five fixed hex status colors bypass current semantic theme colors. The comment at lines 14-16 still claims MetricBar composes glow, but current inspected MetricBar has gradient fill and no glow style.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse restrained semantic CSS variables for status colors; pass MetricBar fill='solid' where appropriate. Preserve status order, labels, counts and proportion; update obsolete glow comment during implementation.

visualIssues.detail: MetricBar defaults to gradient fill because caller omits fill. Combined with fluorescent processing color this adds avoidable visual intensity to secondary distribution bars.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing fill='solid' contract with toned semantic colors; do not introduce a competing progress renderer or delete numeric distribution.

visualIssues.detail: Download anchor repeats ad-hoc action chrome/text-sm, fixed cyan text/focus and white-derived hover. This is fixed-white surface noise, not pure-white body text. No text-white or glow class was found in the assigned page.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing shared link/button styling with semantic text/hover/focus tokens, retaining native href/download semantics, label and 44px target.

visualIssues.detail: Shared Helix outline action fixes cyan border, background, focus and dark cyan-100 text; its surface competes with neutral operational chrome. Source risk only, not measured excess brightness or contrast failure.
visualIssues.fix: Shared AI owner should align existing action with subdued semantic/brand tokens while preserving contextual accessible name, disabled/busy state, wrapping and brand identity; page must not fork this component.

architectureIssues.detail: Bulk mutation returns ExportBulkResult including per-id failed reasons, but page discards resolved result and clears all selection; hook always emits success toast on resolved result. Partial-success failure retention and useful feedback are absent in this frontend path.
architectureIssues.fix: Consume result.deleted/result.failed, retain failed job IDs for retry and surface localized partial outcome/reasons; coordinate shared hook toast contract without changing live deletion/auth behavior. First verify actual backend response semantics.

architectureIssues.detail: Detail bento uses page-local viewport xl grid rather than shared allocated-width layout. It is currently simple and noncompeting, but container-width behavior must be validated before claiming shared responsive composition.
architectureIssues.fix: Prefer existing layout primitives if their span/width contract preserves the 2:1 jobs/breakdown hierarchy; do not add a new width engine or remove content.

dataBehavior: Keep actual typed API jobs; no fixtures, invented data or synthetic export submission.
No date window or vehicle workspace filter applies to this past-job list. Preserve truthful loaded-snapshot scope; do not add another range selector or infer global totals.
Preserve AbortSignal forwarding, existing query keys, polling enablement, inherited retry/stale policies and invalidation/broadcast.
Preserve raw bytes and snake_case payloads; localized bytes/date/number display only.
Keep table filtered/selected exports distinct from job artifacts and from unimplemented server-full-result exports.
Keep source-retained rows and all neighbors during background refresh failures; preserve no-source null metrics and unresolved/paused copy.
Preserve unknown-status rows in total and bytes; no invented status meaning, no recalculated status ratios with a changed denominator.
Preserve valid zero versus missing/invalid bytes and existing zero-as-empty explanation.
Do not add export creation/account/scheduled actions from useExports.ts merely because the hook module exposes them; they are not this page's actions.
Maintain consent/gating and catalog-only redaction narration; it does not apply redactions or trigger deterministic exports.
